description: Wakefield Metropolitan District Council is a metropolitan borough (treated as unitary for AI DOGE purposes). Quarterly Supplier Spend feed published via Data Mill North. Modern (2023+) layout uses Date + Amount; legacy (pre-2023) layout uses Payment Date + Net Amount. Supplier 'REDACTED' rows are direct payments to individuals (Care Act / fostering / SGO / ASC) and must be excluded from supplier-league + duplicate / split forensic analyses. Top-supplier-by-£ is dominated by WAKEFIELD WASTE PFI LTD (legitimate single-supplier PFI contract — keep as procurement_paid, do not bucket). Cloned from durham template; revisit after top-30 audit for any settlement-noise / accrual / pension-fund buckets.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — direct payments to individuals (foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct payments, CYP direct payments). Wakefield's modern feed publishes 'REDACTED' as the supplier name for affected payments.
